evidence.en:
I - I am forwarding you for the necessary provisions
regarding the facts that occurred on the night of 21/09/86 between 1400 and
2200 hours.

At 0015Z on 22 September, we received a call on the TF-1
(Il.Ut/U6) from Ten Paulo, Chief of ACC BS, reporting sightings by two aircraft
flying between Rio and Sao Paulo.

We requested ACC BS to instruct pilots, after landing, to contact COpM without
making any calls.

We initiated video recording at 0018Z with overviews of Rio and Sao Paulo, and
at 0030Z

evidence.en: This questionnaire was completed by pilot RALPH, flight 285 of VASP, who provided us with the following information regarding the unusual objects observed on 30/08/86 at 08:16Z.

- Pilot of PT-MBZ, Sr. ALCIR PEREIRA DA SILVA, resident in São José dos Campos, Av. JOÃO BATISTA CLARES DE QUEIROZ 1875 (phone 227624), a EMBRAER employee, stated that upon approaching SBSJ, he observed two large red objects. He was unable to validate their speed or equipment. The sky was clear. The observation of these objects was initiated by the pilot himself, who did not approach them.

- At the same time, the APP-AN operator, Sgt. MÁRCIO, reported detecting an "echo" on the "Anápolis radar"
